external_mathematical_dependencies.policy: Established published results may be explicit hypotheses. Verify their precise quotation and our application; do not require formal proofs of the cited results. Internal unproved lemmas are not external results. Conditional deductions must be labelled as such.

external_mathematical_dependencies.review_note: The register and source hashes document the boundary. They do not themselves prove that the published theorem and its formal statement are semantically equivalent.

scope: Of the 37 numbered proved statements, 36 have checked mathematical content: 24 checked and 12 checked_core, with no partial entries. The corollary on random regular graphs is not formalized: it combines the checked regular-expander corollary with published spectral-gap theorems for random regular graphs. The other unverified numbered statement is the explicitly unproved biased-subset research target. Actual algorithm correctness, reductions, constraint arithmetic, enumeration and exponential search-node bounds are checked for all four main families and the proved appendix results. The independent-pair auxiliary proposition is now explicitly scoped to integer coefficients, as in every computational input model in the paper; the earlier additional assertion for arbitrary continuously distributed real coefficients is not claimed. This changes no Max 2-SAT/Max Cut input family. General original probability spaces, almost-sure integer bounds, independent product transport, exact expectations and ordinary variance are checked. Discovery yields a measurable good event uniform in all subsequently chosen units, with one fixed base c<2 and constants for every size. Two published probability estimates remain explicit hypotheses, with source quotations and their applications audited separately. No internal proof obligation is classified as external. Standard-axiom checking does not prove those hypotheses. Polynomial bit-operation overhead and polynomial space remain conventional manuscript arguments, not machine-cost or compiler proofs. The registry and fingerprints track intended paper correspondence; independent review of its semantic correctness remains distinct from kernel checking. See SUBMISSION_SCOPE.txt for the final boundary; older milestone notes record historical states.
